title: Evitar cierre terminal por abort de allocator inválido
mission: Repair return/outcome semantics so a post-claim abort caused by a stale or contract-incompatible allocator hint cannot terminally close an unfinished dedupe key. Preserve terminal NO_ACTION_NEEDED for cases that genuinely satisfy/close the job, while stale allocator aborts remain nonterminal evidence and the unmet acceptance criteria stay visible/actionable. Do not rewrite historical receipts; reconcile them append-only and do not promote production /w.
definition_of_done: A stale/incompatible allocator reservation that performs no substantive job mutation has a distinct nonterminal outcome or machine-readable abort classification instead of terminally closing the dedupe key.
NO_ACTION_NEEDED remains terminal only when the job itself is genuinely closed by durable evidence, not merely because one attempted route was invalid.

The poisoned portfolio-exclusive-job-pin-live-race-5-v1 history is reconciled without deleting or rewriting its historical G000002 pin/return receipts, and its unmet fixed-G000001 acceptance remains legible.
Live/feed/allocator terminal derivation agrees on the repaired semantics.
Regression coverage includes stale allocator abort, genuine NO_ACTION_NEEDED, and PARTIAL/BOUNDARY behavior.
A fresh replacement fixture can be materialized for any irreversibly terminal historical canary without pretending the old fixture passed.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
